inputs: Immutable request and complete briefing; selected CLI presentation mode
behaviors.completion: Thin PS5.1/7 launcher accepts Request, Briefing, RunDir, Reason, Python and ShowProgress, forwards exact arguments and exit status to Python without policy duplication.
outputs: Retained evidence or explicit failure with no valid advice
prerequisites: Native Windows, Python >=3.10; PowerShell 5.1 or 7 for wrapper
effects: Fresh run evidence only; no parent environment, operational package or prior evidence edits
behaviors.failure: Retain failure evidence; never relax auth, flags, limits or validation.
behaviors.recovery: Investigate preserved failure; only authorized remaining attempt may use same immutable request.

helper_contract.inputs: Explicit request/run/briefing/reason and optional progress; deterministic cases for evaluator
helper_contract.outputs: Final JSON on stdout, optional safe progress on stderr and retained evidence files
helper_contract.runtime: Windows Python >=3.10 standard library; launcher Windows PowerShell 5.1 or PowerShell 7
helper_contract.effects: One bounded subprocess attempt or deterministic evaluation; never framework acceptance
helper_contract.errors: Runner 0 valid response, 1 completed invalid/failed attempt, 2 blocked input/history; wrapper propagates child status
helper_contract.reuse_reason: Centralize validation/evidence and avoid duplicating policy in shell
